justification: The evidence extensively demonstrates operational robustness. It includes evaluations under standard conditions (95.2% accuracy), multiple perturbation tests (accuracies of 92.8%, 90.9%, 93.4%), robust handling of removed non-critical fields (93.7%), resilience to OCR degradation (92.1%), formatting variations (91.6% to 94.8%), and a highly functioning out-of-distribution detection mechanism that flagged 1,127 out of 1,200 out-of-distribution documents. These evaluations have also been independently reproduced by a separate validation team. This comprehensive coverage of stress tests and validation protocols strongly supports the attribution of operational robustness in its deployment context.
evidence_used: With 10% randomly removed non-critical fields, accuracy was 93.7%.
With the predefined OCR degradation transformation, accuracy was 92.1%.
Across the predefined formatting-variation set, accuracy ranged from 91.6% to 94.8%.
An out-of-distribution test set contained 1,200 documents from document classes excluded from training.
Of the 1,200 out-of-distribution samples, 1,127 were flagged by the out-of-distribution mechanism.
The validation protocol contains three predefined perturbation tests; corresponding accuracies were 92.8%, 90.9%, and 93.4%.
A separate validation team reproduced the reported tests.
